publication issues.summary:
50 unresolved wire glyph discrepancies and seven uncertainties; 10 positional routing comparisons unequal and not yet verified, registration, branch ownership, continuity and omissions remain open.

Team7 subsequently compared unit-edge unions for 45 same-position pairs between the older raw source and this selected V4: all 45 pairs matched as positional unions, while 16 zero-length raw segments were excluded and remain separately recorded. The earlier ordered-list comparison had 35 equal and 10 unequal; union equality does not establish ordered-list identity, source-net-to-V4 identity, branch or junction ownership, native continuity or electrical correctness. The selected V4 and TXT differ from the earlier baseline source model and TXT; the compared V4 is the currently selected model. All 50 wire-render flags, original-only omissions, complete native routes, independent edge/warp and ownership remain open.
publication issues.qualification: Published for access with the recorded review limitations; no electrical correctness or user approval asserted.
